0022600086.text: Both the Washington Wizards and Milwaukee Bucks open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Wizards at home. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. Milwaukee has Jericho Sims (day-to-day, undisclosed reason) and Nate Ament (day-to-day, ankle sprain) listed as game-time decisions. The Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat the Bucks 109-99 in their last meeting, on January 29, 2026 in Washington, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Washington a 65% chance to win.
